speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the consultation. I see you are a newborn presenting with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin; tell me, how many days old is your baby now, and when did you first notice this jaundice?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiologic Jaundice exacerbated by insufficient intake).

The infant is 2 weeks old with weight gain and exclusively breastfed, suggesting adequate intake and a likely self-limiting condition rather than pathological causes like hemolysis. I will monitor bilirubin levels to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other etiologies.
